independent_reviewer_conclusion: The old fixed120cm analog-approach denominator is shorter than a normal movement step at observed low frame rates. Scaling the existing AddMovementInput request by the raw observed game-frame interval is legitimate waypoint-controller timing, while preserving normal620cm/s maximum,35cm actual arrival and all original route/camera/ground checks. The known world geometry defect still needs its independent exact two-rock correction and original failure ray/arc proof.
limitations: The one-frame distance bound assumes a comparable next frame interval and does not bypass actual physics, acceleration,35cm arrival or stall checks.
Programmatic analog input is not a physical-keyboard playtest.
